benchmark_profile.name: Soak - Standalone, overnight STEADY state
benchmark_profile.description: Memory-leak soak: populate 100K keys, then hold 80/20 GET/SET for 13.5 hours. Duration is sized to land results in S3 well before a fixed morning deadline, not to a round number of hours -- deliberately named without the length so retiming the run does not make the filename lie. Connection count is supplied by the matrix runner, which overwrites it on every phase. Paired with scripts/plot_memory.py to check whether process RSS is flat or rising.

phases.description: Populate the keyspace with sequential SETs so STEADY GETs hit
